name: Wildwalker's tamed animal spirit wears the Animal Spirit Visual Aura (#5309)
contract: Animal Spirit Visual Aura 574306 (Primalist family 37, passive) applies its ghostly state visual (SpellVisual
87401, 8fx_generic_ghostly_state) to the caster's summons through effect 190. Nothing taught it, and its
TargetCreatureType 1 made the learning self-cast fail on a humanoid player. Spirit Beast Master 92148 now teaches
it with the spec's other spells, the creature-type gate moves to the aura's area-target check (beasts only), and
the tamed beast carries the aura. Expected: after choosing spec 59 the Primalist knows 574306, and the beast
tamed through Harness Animal Spirit has 574306 from the Primalist. Client rendering is not observable here.

steps.label: SETUP: Spirit Beast Master is known
Choosing the spec teaches the Animal Spirit Visual Aura
The tamed beast wears the visual aura
